question: Change the Type field in corev1.ServiceSpec (k8s.io/api/core/v1) from value type ServiceType to pointer type *ServiceType. Service.Spec.Type is read by controllers, ingress controllers, and DNS providers to determine routing behavior (e.g. LoadBalancer vs ClusterIP). Any code that compares svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer or switches on the value will break because pointer dereferencing and nil checks are now required.
